description.narrative: The development impact of the Project will be delivered through increased access to finance for MSMEs in Pakistan, including those in the agricultural sector, via investing in the inaugural notes issued under the Banks DPR program. Beyond the project level outcomes, IFC anticipates that by demonstrating the viability of a DPR structure, the first one to be established by a bank in Pakistan, it will spur replication by other banks fostering resilience of Pakistans financial sector.

The proposed project aims to provide financing of up to US$100 million, for up to 5 years, to Bank Al Falah (BAFL or the Bank), a long-standing IFC client, through the first of its kind Diversified Payments Rights (DPR) program established by a bank in Pakistan, with IFC as the anchor investor (the Project). The proceeds of IFCs investment will enable the Bank to increase its support to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and Agri sectors in Pakistan that will be identified as per IFC definitions.
